u204.name: Thrill of Blood
base: Gains [Toughness] and [Daunting Counter]; gains the skill [Crimson Tether].
After an active attack: Takes [Piercing DMG] equal to 30% of current HP; inflicts 1 stack of [Bleed] (lasts 1 turn) and 1 stack of [Wound] (lasts 3 turns) on the enemy.

1: Increases max HP by 10%, and M.ATK by 5%.
Gains an aura: All enemies in battle affected by [Bleed] or [Bloodthorn Seed] have final DMG reduced by 4% and final DMG taken increased by 4%.
2: Increases max HP by 10%, and M.ATK by 5%.
Gains an aura: All enemies in battle affected by [Bleed] or [Bloodthorn Seed] have final DMG reduced by 7% and final DMG taken increased by 7%.
3: Increases max HP by 20%, M.ATK by 10%, and Movement by 1 tile.
Gains an aura: All enemies in battle affected by [Bleed] or [Bloodthorn Seed] have final DMG reduced by 7% and final DMG taken increased by 7%.
After casting [Crimson Tether], recovers 1 NRG and additionally inflicts 1 stack of [Bleed] (lasts 2 turns).
4: Increases max HP by 20%, M.ATK by 10%, and Movement by 1 tile.
Gains an aura: All enemies in battle affected by [Bleed] or [Bloodthorn Seed] have final DMG reduced by 10% and final DMG taken increased by 10%.
After casting [Crimson Tether], recovers 1 NRG and additionally inflicts 1 stack of [Bleed] (lasts 2 turns).
5: Increases max HP by 30%, M.ATK by 15%, and Movement by 1 tile; gains [Climb] and [Jump].
Gains an aura: All enemies in battle affected by [Bleed] or [Bloodthorn Seed] have final DMG reduced by 10% and final DMG taken increased by 10%.
After casting [Crimson Tether], recovers 2 NRG and additionally inflicts 1 stack of [Bleed] (lasts 2 turns) and 1 stack of [Bloodthorn Seed].
